hypothesis: V15 upper-Bollinger long edges should contain a complementary continuation engine when the latest completed 30-minute auction is trending_up_clean under the fixed period-21 ATR-efficiency, Kaufman-efficiency and ADX state.

fixed_policy.signal: one completed-5m close crossing above the upper Bollinger band

implementation_history.first_run_reason: The diagnostic imported the inherited candidate-51 router rather than the materialized V15 indicator path.
implementation_history.repair: The workflow now materializes router_zaratustra_v15.py and the shared regime module before the audit.

windows.comparison: The only clean-up edge immediately failed; no opportunity capacity existed.
Clean-up was worse than the other states on both favorable excursion and close follow-through.

windows.causal_concentration: A disproportionate share of the strongest clean-up excursions came from the same multi-asset upside event on 2026-04-07, with repeated BTC/ETH/SOL edges. They are not independent evidence.
windows.comparison: The state improved maximum favorable excursion in this month but did not improve realized 60-minute direction; the average close remained cost-after negative.

reason: The fixed clean-up state did not convert V15 upper-band crosses into a repeatable continuation decision. The only strong-looking month still had negative close expectancy and was concentrated in one causal market rally. Running a Nautilus account or tuning thresholds would spend resources on a selector whose predicted state separation was not observed.
preserved_clue: Some clean-up edges produced delayed favorable excursion after initial adverse movement. This is an entry-geometry clue, not evidence for the current family. A pullback/re-break study is warranted only if an independently specified causal setup predicts which of those excursions survive and is tested on untouched episodes.
